svg.title: Riju matches the station passenger to one pupil across three valid registers.
svg.desc: A deterministic reference token links the passenger flagged at the Halt to one pupil in the maroon attendance, green flood-displacement and blue election-use registers. Vale notes that the contradictory states belong to the question, not necessarily the child.
svg.text: Page 16, panel 2 · Top-down medium shot on the three open blank registers

text.tspan: Riju confirms the station passenger is the same
pupil and discovers that contradictory attendance
states can all be true for different purposes.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
